draft.subject: Re: Checking in on Bright Logistics' setup
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks for the reply  f03 glad the project side is underway. Since projects are the main organizing unit and tasks live inside them, the next step that usually makes Wrenfield click is getting your team's real tasks into that project alongside a teammate or two. A teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and teammates can be bulk-invited from a CSV file instead of one at a time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through what to set up first.

Best,
Chidi
